assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one approved two-row by three-column transparent atlas for a first-grade classroom observation game; six separately cropped game illustrations. Create one 1536x1024-style wide atlas with a precise invisible 2x3 layout on true alpha. Each illustration is independently centered in its grid cell with fully clear outer margins of at least 12% of cell width and height. Keep the subjects completely inside their own cells. No grid lines, borders, cards, checkerboards, shadows extending into adjacent cells, text, labels, arrows, digits, marks, or brand. Use the approved illustration style: delicate fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper silhouettes, pine green and warm cream with apricot highlights, clear high contrast and no dark field behind the objects. The child must immediately see whether a view is from overhead or from the side. Row 1 is strictly orthographic overhead; row 2 is strictly orthographic low side elevation. Each column shows exactly one and the same physical object in both views, with matching distinctive shapes, materials, and colors.
Row 1 column 1: A single round navy cloth-padded classroom stool seen exactly from above, circular navy seat with conspicuous woven threads and one apricot stitched ring. Legs are hidden by the larger seat disk.
Row 1 column 2: A single small rounded rectangular light-teal transparent plastic craft case seen exactly from above, white inside, one large apricot thread spool visible through the clear lid, one small brushed-silver front latch at the center of its bottom long edge.
Row 1 column 3: A single slim rectangular honey-colored wooden clipboard seen exactly from above, small silver spring clamp at the upper short edge holding a plain warm cream card with a single pale sage spot. Unmarked, no letters, wood grain visible on board border.
Row 2 column 1: Exactly the same stool as row 1 column 1 from a true frontal side elevation. See a thin navy woven padded rim and the same apricot stitching ring as a thin arc, and three visible honey wood legs with unmistakable grain under the seat. Keep the whole stool and feet in its cell.
Row 2 column 2: Exactly the same teal transparent craft case as row 1 column 2 from a true frontal low elevation. See the same thin translucent lid, one centered metallic latch fully seated on the front, and the same apricot spool faintly visible within the shallow case. No extra latches or objects.
Row 2 column 3: Exactly the same honey wooden clipboard as row 1 column 3 from a true side elevation. See a thin horizontal grained board edge, the thin warm cream card on it, and the single small silver spring clip with its profile projecting upward at the left end. No extra detached parts. All six views preserve the same warm matte materials, with the exception that the plastic lid is clearly transparent and the small metal clips have a restrained highlight.
